Players Committee card image of the flipped side of [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol (Errata 3)]] (errata PC-E3). (Flipped side, unchanged in every version:) If either player just deployed a card with ability here, you may use 1 Force to place The Mythrol out of play; if card was Din Djarin or a bounty hunter, you may activate 2 Force. If about to leave table, place out of play.

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/themythrolback.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/4ab16f9b9c15499d865b4a7165ea8ddb0f451253 4ab16f9]. The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
